prior_protocol_reservation.interpretation: reserved for disjointness; not classified as an observed payload fetch

contamination_ledger.policy: reject a candidate if its layer OR its expert index appeared in any prior opened/reserved pair; this is stricter than pair-only disjointness

future_source_finalization.matrix_hash: SHA-256 of exact contiguous BF16 payload bytes
future_source_finalization.required_order: first freeze codec and blind allocator against this exact proposal; only then create a separate source-finalization lock

gates_if_adopted.primary_pass: integrity && exact route-inclusive physical bpw <= 2.15 && pooled original-BF16 FP64 SSE/energy < 2^-4.3
gates_if_adopted.reporting: v2 is a new confirmatory panel; never pool/select it with v1 after observing either result

population_validation.validation_inputs: cached safetensors index and JSON headers only

payload_interlock.next_permitted_step: continue source-free codec work or create an audited codec freeze; do not fetch selected ranges

proposal_semantics.purpose: precommit a rigorously disjoint second panel while codec development remains separate

seed.source: raw SHA-256 of the immutable v1 independent-audit summary file
seed.why_not_free_form: the failed v1 outcome fixes all seed bytes; there is no user-selected salt, timestamp, or retry counter

selection_algorithm.choice: lexicographically smallest 32-byte score in each stratum
selection_algorithm.eligibility: layer index absent from all prior opened/reserved pairs AND expert index absent from all prior opened/reserved pairs
selection_algorithm.uniformity_model: uniform over the declared eligible set in each stratum under the SHA-256 random-oracle model

v1_failure_reaudit.note: the separate machine-specific re-audit receipt is evidence, not selection randomness or a path-dependent selection binding
